title: Terra Nova — Tectonic Creed
revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Earth classification / forked tree

classification.selector: jutsu classification: the qualifying element(s), whatever the jutsu's source
classification.applies_to: matching supported tags on all Earth jutsu
not_selectors: equipment / required bloodline item (castability gate only)
classification.off_kit_coverage: unverified (no non-bloodline jutsu catalog with effect rows in the repository)

emphasis.primary: Earth strikes (Fault Line): raw Damage on Earthen Fortitude and Terra Spire, or Earthen Fortitude's suppression
emphasis.secondary: Earth Wall's window (Bedrock Stance): Decrease Damage Taken or Earth-only Increase Damage Given
emphasis.tertiary: No riders: each capstone carries one effect. The kit has no Afterburn, Heal, Lifesteal or Reflect rows
emphasis.rationale: Fault Line answers "How do I make my Earth strikes decide the exchange?": Continental Rift adds raw Damage to both 38 EP Earth attacks (+2, 38 → 40, the only route to the 40 Normal line) and Pressure of Ages takes Earthen Fortitude's suppression to 40%. Bedrock Stance answers "How do I use Earth Wall's two rounds?": Unmoved Mountain holds (Decrease Damage Taken 45%) and Landslide Momentum strikes (Earth-only Increase Damage Given 45%). Raw Damage and the Earth Wall amplify multiply each other, so they sit under different Foundations: the +2 Damage builds carry at most +2% Increase Damage Given and the +10% Increase Damage Given builds carry no Damage. Burst owns every cast (40 against 38 EP); Landslide Momentum owns the wall's window (38 × 1.45 = 55.1 against 40 × 1.37 = 54.8). Potency reaches matching supported tags on all Earth jutsu (RUL-2026-10-03-005).

nodes.name: Fault Line
nodes.flavor: The ground splits where you choose, and your enemy stands on the wrong side.
nodes.coverage_note: In the kit, only Earthen Fortitude carries a Decrease Damage Given row: 30 → 32% for the 2 rounds after its hit, on one enemy. The strike family's root carries no Damage, so raw Damage stays on the Burst route.

nodes.name: Rending Strata
nodes.flavor: Layer by layer, the earth is torn open.
nodes.coverage_note: Both Earth Damage rows (Earthen Fortitude single target, Terra Spire spiral around the caster) 38 → 39 EP, still Light tier. A commitment step; Continental Rift carries the step to the 40 Normal line.

nodes.name: Continental Rift
nodes.flavor: When the plates move, nothing built upon them survives.
nodes.coverage_note: Burst: both Earth Damage rows 38 → 40 EP on the full route (+2 Damage), reaching the 40 Normal line on every cast; no other allocation passes 39. The Earth damage passive multiplies the result.

nodes.name: Burden of Stone
nodes.flavor: Every swing drags the weight of a quarry behind it.
nodes.coverage_note: In the kit, only Earthen Fortitude carries this row (one enemy, 2 rounds, 60 AP, cooldown 7): Decrease Damage Given 35% with Fault Line. Terra Spire's recoil is untouched.

nodes.name: Pressure of Ages
nodes.flavor: What the mountain presses down stays pressed down.
nodes.coverage_note: Suppression: Earthen Fortitude Decrease Damage Given 30 → 40% on the full route, live the 2 rounds after its hit. One effect, no rider.

nodes.name: Bedrock Stance
nodes.flavor: Plant your feet where the stone runs deepest.
nodes.coverage_note: In the kit, only Earth Wall carries these rows (40 AP self cast, range 0, cooldown 7, 2 rounds): Decrease Damage Taken 35 → 37%; Increase Damage Given 35 → 37% on Earth hits only.

nodes.name: Rampart Discipline
nodes.flavor: A wall is only as patient as the one who raised it.
nodes.coverage_note: In the kit, only Earth Wall carries a Decrease Damage Taken row (self, 2 rounds): 40% with Bedrock Stance. No element, four stat types: most non-pierce hits.

nodes.name: Unmoved Mountain
nodes.flavor: Storms wear themselves out against it, and the mountain does not notice.
nodes.coverage_note: Fortress: Earth Wall Decrease Damage Taken 35 → 45% on the full route, for the 2 rounds after its cast. One effect; the Earth amplify stays at Bedrock Stance's 37%.

nodes.name: Weight Behind the Blow
nodes.flavor: The strike carries the whole hillside with it.
nodes.coverage_note: In the kit, only Earth Wall carries an Increase Damage Given row (self, 2 rounds): 40% with Bedrock Stance, on Earth-element hits only; no stat filter.

nodes.name: Landslide Momentum
nodes.flavor: Once the slope begins to move, it does not stop for anyone.
nodes.coverage_note: Sustained amplification: Earth Wall Increase Damage Given 35 → 45% on Earth hits on the full route, for the 2 rounds after its cast (×1.45 / 1.35 ≈ ×1.074 over the unbought wall). In the window a 38 EP attack lands at 55.1 EP-equivalent, ahead of Burst plus Bedrock Stance's 40 × 1.37 = 54.8.

examples.name: Continental Rift
examples.rationale: Both Earth attacks 38 → 40 EP on every cast with no setup window (Terra Spire on each enemy in its spiral), before the Earth damage passive multiplies them; Fault Line leaves Earthen Fortitude's suppression at 32%. Bedrock Stance is the realistic fourth: Earth Wall at 37% Decrease Damage Taken and 37% Earth amplify, so a 40 EP strike in the window lands at 40 × 1.37 = 54.8, just under Landslide Momentum's 55.1; outside the window Burst leads 40 to 38. Burden of Stone (suppression 35%) is the strike-only alternative.

examples.name: Pressure of Ages
examples.rationale: Earthen Fortitude as a control cast: the target's damage is cut by 40% (30% base) on the two rounds after the hit, against the caster and allies alike for any stat-based or element-less hit, pierce excluded. Bedrock Stance is the fourth purchase: Earth Wall Decrease Damage Taken 37% and Earth amplify 37%. Against the struck enemy that is 0.60 × 0.63 = 0.378 of its damage, slightly more than Unmoved Mountain plus Fault Line's 0.374; the case is the party, whose damage taken from that enemy the debuff also cuts. Rending Strata (attacks 39 EP) is the alternative.

examples.name: Unmoved Mountain
examples.rationale: Earth Wall Decrease Damage Taken 45% (35% base) on the two rounds after its cast, against every non-pierce hit whose stat resolves to one of the four stat types or that carries no element, Lightning included despite the bloodline's +10% Lightning weakness; the Earth amplify stays at 37%. Fault Line is the fourth purchase (suppression 32%; 0.68 × 0.55 = 0.374 of the struck enemy's damage, 0.55 of anyone else's); Weight Behind the Blow (Earth amplify 40%) is the offensive alternative.

examples.name: Landslide Momentum
examples.rationale: Earth Wall Increase Damage Given 45% (35% base) on the two rounds after its cast, on Earth-element damage only: both kit attacks and any Earth normal jutsu, not basic attacks or non-Earth jutsu. All three kit jutsu share cooldown 7, so timing both attacks into the window is the route's skill test: there a 38 EP attack lands at 38 × 1.45 = 55.1, ahead of Burst plus Bedrock Stance (54.8). Rampart Discipline is the fourth purchase (Decrease Damage Taken 40% on the same cast); Fault Line (suppression 32%) is the alternative.

design_notes: Structure kept: Fault Line (Earthen Fortitude's suppression) forks into Rending Strata → Continental Rift (burst) and Burden of Stone → Pressure of Ages (suppression); Bedrock Stance (both Earth Wall rows) forks into Rampart Discipline → Unmoved Mountain (fortress) and Weight Behind the Blow → Landslide Momentum (amplification). 2 F / 4 H / 4 A; every capstone 3 BP deep; any two capstones cost 5–6 BP. An offense/defense split (Damage with Increase Damage Given, Decrease Damage Taken with Decrease Damage Given) was considered and rejected: raw Damage and the Earth Wall amplify multiply each other, so one Foundation would let a capstone plus its sibling Hidden Art stack both.

2026-10-04 rebalance: Burst cut from +5 Damage (Rending Strata +2, Continental Rift +3; 38 → 43 on both attacks, one an area spiral) to +2 (Rending Strata +1, Continental Rift +1; 38 → 39 → 40), so the Hidden Art no longer crosses the 40 Normal line and Landslide Momentum owns the wall's window (calibration below). Pressure of Ages' +1 Damage rider is removed with no replacement, so no build outside Burst passes 39 EP and the suppression capstone does not out-guard the fortress. Unmoved Mountain's +2% Increase Damage Given and Landslide Momentum's +2% Decrease Damage Taken riders are removed: each fed its sibling Hidden Art's tag, so both capstones' best fourth purchase converged on the same all-Earth-Wall package (45%/42% against 42%/45%).

Calibration (uptime-aware): Burst's +2 EP is ×40 / 38 ≈ ×1.053 on every Earth cast, in or out of the window. Landslide Momentum's +10% is ×1.45 / 1.35 ≈ ×1.074 on Earth hits in Earth Wall's two-round window only. Inside the window Burst plus Bedrock Stance gives (B + 2) × 1.37 against Landslide Momentum's 1.45B; break-even is B ≈ 34 EP, so Landslide Momentum leads on every player-tier row (38: 54.8 against 55.1; 50: 71.2 against 72.5) and Burst leads everywhere else. At the earlier +3, (B + 3) × 1.37 ≥ 1.45B up to B ≈ 51.4 EP, so Burst out-hit Landslide Momentum even inside its own window. Defense: Unmoved Mountain's 45% is ×0.55 / 0.65 ≈ ×0.85 damage taken in the window; Pressure of Ages' 40% is ×0.60 / 0.70 ≈ ×0.86 on one enemy's hits for two rounds. With both windows aligned (Earth Wall 40 AP plus Earthen Fortitude 60 AP fit in one round), Unmoved plus Fault Line takes 0.68 × 0.55 = 0.374 of the struck enemy's damage against Pressure plus Bedrock Stance's 0.60 × 0.63 = 0.378, and 0.55 against 0.63 from anyone else.

Rending Strata keeps a +1 Damage commit (38 → 39, Light) because each non-Damage alternative fails: any Increase Damage Given re-merges the multiplying pair (even +1% puts Burst plus Bedrock Stance at 40 × 1.38 = 55.2, over Landslide Momentum's 55.1 in its own window); any Decrease Damage Given lets Pressure of Ages plus Rending Strata pass +10% and makes the sibling Hidden Art Pressure's best fourth; Decrease Damage Taken is Earth Wall's defensive row and fits neither half of Fault Line's sentence.

Matching (tags.ts getEfficiencyRatio 3477–3510): the Decrease Damage Taken and Decrease Damage Given rows list four stat types and no element, so they alter every non-pierce hit whose stat resolves to one of the four or that is element-less (basic attacks and weapons included). Earth Wall's Increase Damage Given row has elements ['Earth'] and no stat type: it amplifies Earth-element damage only.

Delivery: all three jutsu have cooldown 7. Earth Wall (40 AP, SELF) buffs are live on the two rounds after its cast (§3b), never in it: 2-in-7 uptime for both wall routes, though both kit attacks share cooldown 7 and can be timed into the window each cycle. Earthen Fortitude (60 AP, range 4, single target) hits in its cast round and suppresses on the two rounds after. Terra Spire (60 AP) hits enemies on a radius-4 spiral around the caster. The Earth damage passive (15% + 0.15/level, fromType bloodline) multiplies last; the +10% Lightning Increase Damage Taken passive is the kit's weakness. Both passives are suppressed in ranked modes (§5).

Fourth purchases: Burst → Bedrock Stance (wall 37%/37%; 54.8 in the window) or Burden of Stone (suppression 35%); Suppression → Bedrock Stance (Decrease Damage Taken 37%, amplify 37%) or Rending Strata (39 EP); Fortress → Fault Line (suppression 32%) or Weight Behind the Blow (amplify 40%); Amplification → Rampart Discipline (Decrease Damage Taken 40%) or Fault Line (suppression 32%).
risks: Classification: Earth is shared with other bloodlines (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). 3 of 5 supported kit rows carry Earth; Earthen Fortitude's Decrease Damage Given and Earth Wall's Decrease Damage Taken rows carry no element and need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, so two of the four routes depend on it. Off-kit Earth coverage is unverified.

Off-kit flat Damage: Continental Rift's +2 reaches every Earth Damage row, not only the kit's two 38 EP rows. An off-kit Earth row at 45 or 50 would read 47 or 52; the validator enumerates kit rows only.

Earth-only amplify: Earth Wall's Increase Damage Given row matches Earth damage alone (its element list lacks None), so Landslide Momentum's 45% skips basic attacks and non-Earth jutsu, and its value depends on landing Earth hits in the two-round window.

Broad fortification: Unmoved Mountain puts Earth Wall's Decrease Damage Taken at 45% for 2 rounds, matching every non-pierce hit whose stat is one of the four or that is element-less, Lightning included. Same-tag effects all apply (process.ts 1109–1117), so it compounds with any other Decrease Damage Taken on the caster. Cooldown 7 exceeds the 2 rounds, so own casts never overlap.

Suppression reach: Pressure of Ages puts Earthen Fortitude's Decrease Damage Given at 40% for 2 rounds on one target; the debuff also reduces that enemy's damage to the caster's allies, so the route is worth more in team battles than one row suggests. It is a single-target 60 AP cast on cooldown 7; the kit has no area suppression.

Single-cast concentration: each capstone depends on one jutsu (Earth Wall for the wall routes, Earthen Fortitude for suppression, both attacks for burst), so a prevented or sealed cast removes the route's value for that cooldown cycle.

Terra Spire's recoil and wound rows are unsupported. The wound row lacks friendlyFire (= ALL), so allies inside the caster-centred spiral receive the wound and the caster never does (actions.ts 1029–1060). No node touches it, but the Burst route invites casting Spire near allies.

Highest-stat resolution (§4b): both damage rows list statTypes 'Highest', resolved from the caster's highestOffence, so enemy Decrease Damage Taken buffs and Decrease Damage Given debuffs with four-stat filters match and blunt the boosted hits.

Formula damage scales linearly with EP (tags.ts powerEffect 1436–1462), so +2 EP is ×1.053 on a 38 EP row before Earth Wall's amplify and the Earth passive multiply it. No combat simulation was performed; main-tree effects, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.

audit.revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Earth classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).

Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Earth jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.
Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.
Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.

design_review.status: Fable proposal (2026-10-04 batch rebalance); not director-approved

foundation_sentences.01: How do I make my Earth strikes decide the exchange: hit harder, or leave the struck enemy weaker?
foundation_sentences.06: How do I use Earth Wall's two rounds: hold behind it, or strike from it?

route_identities.03: burst: raw Damage on every Earth strike, no setup window
route_identities.05: suppression: the struck enemy hits softer for the whole party
route_identities.08: fortress: take less from nearly every hit in the wall's window
route_identities.10: sustained amplification: Earth hits timed into the wall's window land hardest

concerns: Off-kit flat Damage is unverified: Continental Rift's +2 reaches every Earth Damage row, so an off-kit Earth row at 50 would read 52; the validator checks kit rows only.

Landslide Momentum's in-window lead over Burst plus Bedrock Stance is narrow on the kit's 38 EP attacks (55.1 against 54.8 EP-equivalent, about 0.5%) and widens with base (72.5 against 71.2 on a 50 row); Burst leads 40 to 38 outside the window. Not simulated.

Burst is two +1 Damage steps (×1.026 each): its value is uptime, not size. Rending Strata keeps the +1 commit because every non-Damage alternative breaks the window split, the +10% Decrease Damage Given ceiling or Fault Line's sentence (design notes).
Two of four routes (Pressure of Ages, Unmoved Mountain) amplify element-less rows that the current row-element resolver cannot reach; they depend on the proposed jutsu-classification resolver.
